scope: Read-only static firmware audit + live read-only QEMU breakpoint trace; no firmware modification or guest UI writes.
root_cause_summary: QEMU ADC bank 2 channel 0 (0x7f032014) returns 0 by default. Original 0x06544990 reads bank 2 ch 0..3 into [0x08e21130 + 0x26] and 0x06544a36 passes [0x08e21130 + 0x26] to directional resistor-ladder decoder 0x06545554. Sample 0 falls inside band 0..0x38 (0..56), returning raw mask 0x20 -> bank0 logical 0x1 (KEY_LEFT). Original repeat engine 0x06543de0 (table 0x08aa8204[0], first_delay=25, repeat_period=10) continuously fires bank0 repeat 0x1 -> 0x0663ecea..0x0663ed22 -> 0x066bddc8(3, 1) -> UI event 0x0f000002 param 0x00010003 -> 0x068b7988 -> 0x068b7742 -> 0x068b759a -> 0x068b754a, decrementing timezone ID [0x08cc4872] continuously (1 -> 0 -> 38 -> 37 ...). Because the 32-entry circular timezone table wraps westward faster than the ~9 s LCD refresh swap cadence, slow frame captures exhibit temporal aliasing that appears as eastward steps (Tehran GMT+3:30 -> Kabul +4:30 -> ... -> Guam/Sydney +10:00).

scene70de_dispatch.effect: Decrements timezone ID at [0x08cc4872] through 32 active entries in table 0x06ee5cf0 (wrapping 0 -> 38).

default_zero_result.scene70de_effect: Falls through to 0x0664e092 (ignored in scene 0x70de); does not step timezone, but will emit repeat UI key 6 (DOWN) in scenes that consume vertical navigation.

secondary_observed_repeat_source_not_cau.idle_threshold_note: Highest band in 0x065454d8 is 0x0322 +/- 0x38 (746..858); 0x3ff (1023) is idle.

limits: Raw 10-bit sample 0x3ff is established strictly against original firmware threshold bands in 0x06545554 and constant [0x063191c4]=0x03ff; physical resistor-ladder voltages are not measured.
Setting adc2-ch0-sample=0x3ff addresses only ADC bank 2 channel 0; unrelated GPIOs and other ADC channels (including ADC bank 0 channel 5) remain at default 0.
